changes.what: The MPSC approved, with modifications, DTE Electric's update of rate book Section C3 so that customers taking service after 1 October 2025 with at least 500 MW, or under the Large Load Provision of Rate Schedule No. D11, are subject to firm load shedding before other customers.

The MPSC approved, with modifications, an application from DTE Electric Co. to update its emergency electric procedures in section C3 of the utility’s rate book

customers that take service from the utility after Oct. 1, 2025, with at least 500 MWs of capacity or customers that take service under DTE Electric’s Large Load Provision of Rate Schedule No. D11 will now be subject to firm load shedding prior to other customers
(Case No. U-22059)

changes.rule_name: Special contracts with Google LLC (Primary Supply Agreement under Rate Schedule D11 and Clean Capacity Accelerator Agreement), Van Buren Township data center
changes.source_title: MPSC approves DTE Electric energy contracts for Google data center, protects other customers from the project's costs (MPSC news release, 1 October 2026)
changes.what: The MPSC approved, with conditions, DTE Electric's primary supply agreement and clean capacity accelerator agreement with Google, with a 20-year contract and an 80 percent minimum billing demand (against 5-year contracts and 50 to 65 percent under the general D11 rate).

cites.quote: October 01, 2026

The Michigan Public Service Commission today approved special contracts between DTE Electric Co. and Google LLC for the utility to provide electricity for a data center in Wayne County’s Van Buren Township, conditioned on mandatory protections to prevent other customers from having to bear any costs associated with the project (Case No. U-22058).
A contract length of 20 years, compared to 5-year contracts normally required under DTE Electric’s large-load D11 rate.
A minimum billing demand of 80%, compared to 50%-65% in the general D11 rate.

changes.license_basis: the MPSC's own news release on michigan.gov
